invalidation_conditions: Revalidate when any specialist freshness dependency changes or disappears.

payload.one_line: Owns axum::serve listener acceptance, hyper/tokio connection tasks, listener adapters, and signal-driven graceful draining.
payload.covers: Serve futures, accept retry, hyper-util adaptation, Tokio executor, IncomingStream/connect-info, connection limits, IO hooks, and shutdown examples/tests.
payload.excludes: Routing, handlers, middleware, application timeouts, and TLS/QUIC runtimes outside axum::serve.

flows.name: Serve and graceful drain
flows.description: The listener accepts connections, hyper serves them, and a signal drains in-flight tasks.

steps.what_happens: Serve::run accepts listeners and spawns hyper connection tasks.
Listener implementations retry transient accept failures and provide adapters.

touchpoints.role: Listener abstraction, retry, connection limits, and IO hooks.
Pins shutdown, timeout, executor, and IO behavior.

invariants.rule: Serve without graceful shutdown is unending; graceful shutdown waits for connection tasks to drain.
invariants.why: The accept loop and close channel define lifecycle completion.

invariants.rule: Transient accept errors are logged and retried.
invariants.why: Availability must survive transient listener failures.

invariants.rule: Accepted IO and address types satisfy async, Send/static, and diagnostic bounds.
invariants.why: hyper/tokio adapters and tasks require them.

pitfalls.risk: Graceful shutdown is used without bounding in-flight handlers.

entry_questions: Can all in-flight work terminate before shutdown resolves?
Does the change affect accept retry, task spawning, or shutdown drain?
